svg.title: SkillForge entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Four PostgreSQL domain entities with crow's-foot cardinalities, authorship, and a composite-key progress join table.
svg.text: PostgreSQL domain model / Public quests, personal progress, GitHub identities
PK = primary key / FK = foreign key / UQ = unique / ? = nullable; all other fields required.
user_quests: composite PK (user_id, quest_id); progress and XP belong to the developer.
Null creator = seeded quest. Prerequisite notes guide learning; no dependency table or enforced unlocks.
